title: Руки и костюмы в крупных планах: детали героев по листам, чьи руки в кадрах-деталях

set.details: fitted dark brown-black long-sleeve tunic with NARROW close-fitting sleeves (never wide, loose or flowing sleeves); dark brown leather bracers with buckles on both forearms; BARE hands without gloves, slender pale fingers; deep burgundy hooded scarf wrapped around neck and shoulders; crossed brown leather straps over the chest; small silver winged emblem on the left chest; brown belts with a pouch on the right thigh; tall dark boots wrapped with burgundy bands; long white hair in a high ponytail with loose strands

black leather gloves on BOTH hands at all times (never bare hands, never bare fingers); long black high-collared coat with tight long sleeves that tuck into the gloves, buttoned cuffs; black leather straps and buckles across chest and waist; long coat skirt split at front and back; black trousers and heavy buckled black boots; very long straight black hair; three flat stacked silver plate hairpins (kensaikan) on the left side of the head; pale skin
